CAPTION

Five camera apps that will change how your iPhone footage looks.

Most people shoot on the stock camera and wonder why it doesn't look cinematic. It's usually not the phone. It's the app.

01 Blackmagic Camera — free, full manual control, Apple Log and ProRes, LUT preview on set
02 Witness — uploads to a cloud account you own while you're still recording
03 Kino — Instant Grade, so Log footage never lands flat and grey
04 Filmic Pro — the deepest set of controls on iOS
05 Final Cut Camera — free, and it runs four iPhones as one multicam rig

Save this before your next shoot. Which one are you actually using?

(#2 is mine. The other four aren't.)

#iphonefilmmaking #shotoniphone #filmmaking #filmmakingtips #cinematography #cameraapps #applelog #prores #blackmagiccamera #kino #filmicpro #finalcutcamera #videography #colorgrading #indiefilm #runandgun

Export each artboard as PNG from the toolbar — they're 1080×1920, TikTok photo-mode size. Post in canvas order, 1 through 7.

App icons were supplied by hand and live in the repo as icon-<stem>.png; build-slides.py picks up whatever it finds there.
